newsitem.title: USA: China Air 747 engine fails, returns to Los Angeles.
newsitem.headline: China Air 747 engine fails, returns to Los Angeles.

text.p: A China Airlines Boeing 747-400 airliner bound for Taipei returned to Los Angeles International Airport and landed safely shortly after takeoff on Monday because an engine failed, the FAA said.

The pilot had to shut down one of the four engines because its exhaust temperature was too high, then flew the jumbo jet out over the Pacific to dump its fuel and reduce the risk of an accident upon landing, an FAA officer said.
The plane landed at about 4:20 p.m. PDT (2320 GMT) after being airborne for about an hour. Though the number of people on board was not known, the FAA officer said there were no injuries.
